issueReference: issue #360 Mapping Expansion Wave (ME-15+); ME-24 continues the Wave-8 framework-only backlog (catalog 813)
approvalRecord: Qualified-human approval captured on 2026-09-02: five bounded ME-24 mappings from the Wave-8 framework-only backlog were approved at rank 1. Mapping approval is not citation verification; all five clinical sources enter verified:false and pending-verification.

rows.citation: Donnez J, Carmona F, Maitrot-Mantelet L, Dolmans MM, Chapron C. Uterine disorders and iron deficiency anemia. Fertil Steril. 2022;118(4):615-624. PMID 36182260. doi:10.1016/j.fertnstert.2022.08.011.
rows.guard: Require documented adenomyosis, separately established anemia, compatible bleeding/chronology, and competing-cause review; do not infer anemia from adenomyosis alone.

rows.citation: Vourlekis JS, Brown KK, Cool CD, Young DA, Cherniack RM, King TE Jr, Schwarz MI. Acute interstitial pneumonitis: case series and review of the literature. Medicine (Baltimore). 2000;79(6):369-378. PMID 11144035. doi:10.1097/00005792-200011000-00003.
rows.guard: Require documented acute interstitial pneumonitis, objective pulmonary fibrosis, compatible chronology, and alternative-cause review; do not infer fibrosis from acute pneumonitis or dyspnea alone.

rows.citation: Barney J, Piuzzi NS, Akhondi H. Femoral Head Avascular Necrosis. StatPearls [Internet]. Treasure Island (FL): StatPearls Publishing; 2023. PMID 31536264.
